messages.text: I’ll review the pinned endcap implementation and the barrel corrections read-only, checking the geometry, readout gates and evidence bindings separately from the native reruns.

The endcap uses explicit tilted faces and circular clipping, with virtual readout bins over two merged LAr gaps. I’m checking the volume calculation with a separate integration method and whether the native gates can detect forward-coverage failures.

I found a source/material mismatch: k4geo’s 1.3 mm absorber value includes glue and steel, and its driver subtracts those skins to get 1.1 mm of lead. The endcap treats 1.3 mm as lead and then adds its skins. A control calculation gives an 8.385 t increase in core mass. I’ll flag this for an explicit material choice and corrected source wording.

The independent checks agree with the current endcap model: all 24 piece volumes match the polar integration within \(1.01\times10^{-10}\) relative error, and all 60 retained native rays match the plane-intersection crossing counts and active paths within \(3\times10^{-11}\) mm. The endcap auditor records these rays without applying acceptance checks; the corrected barrel auditor now has crossing and material-path gates.

Reviewed **LAYOUT002-PhysVal-endcap-review** at `44ddd54aef096cff9d019dd6b9ee55c06f7b9d7b`, plus barrel corrections at `5f8c505e26f0f325f17d801583042849f06f62a2`. Two P2 findings remain:

- **P2 — absorber thickness is misidentified as a source fact.** [DES-033 line 14]([redacted] says 1.3 mm inner lead, and [endcaps.json line 21]([redacted] implements it. The pinned [k4geo driver](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/blob/e1ba7bc3e0d7291ebe3f6a02abfa784f879e36cb/detector/calorimeter/ECalEndcap_Turbine_o1_v03_geo.cpp#L114) subtracts 0.1 mm glue and 0.1 mm steel from the XML’s 1.3 mm absorber value, giving **1.1 mm lead**. The prototype then adds its own 0.3 mm skins. Keeping adopted skins but using a 1.1 mm lead control reduces core mass from **137.026465 t to 128.641928 t**; lead mass falls by **9.560428 t**. Correct the source wording and explicitly choose the intended lead thickness before retaining material/sampling evidence.

- **P2 — endcap rays do not affect native PASS.** [endcap_native.py line 298]([redacted] records 60 rays but adds no crossing/path/material acceptance conditions. Add expected finite-volume crossings, finite/nonnegative quantities and active-LAr ≤ total-LAr checks, including wheel/support and acceptance-edge directions. Current rays are correct in my independent comparison; this is a regression-gate gap.

Actual checks:

- **23 pinned standard-library tests passed**, including barrel ghost-theta rejection.
- Independent polar integration of all **24 endcap piece volumes** agrees within **1.007×10⁻¹⁰ relative**.
- Independent linear-plane/circular-bound ray intersection matches **all 60 retained native crossing counts** and active paths within **2.985×10⁻¹¹ mm**.
- Separately inspected uncommitted `build/lar-endcaps/native.json`: exact `44ddd54…` execution, source hashes matching that revision, PASS, **9,856 raw IDs; 580 references; 1,203,200 cells; zero overlaps at 10 nm; 139.557395 t**.
- Exclusive service displacement and signed-end/readout conventions are consistent.

The barrel corrections resolve the previous findings: canonical membership rejects ghost addresses; actual fixture/ROOT/log/runner hashes match; log records seed 42, FTFP_BERT and the 10 GeV muon gun. The retained hit has canonical theta 396. Corrected arithmetic gives **1.194 V / 103.684 W** for the 40 m loop, **9.6 Tbit/s** chosen hit payload, **739.403 mm** pipe envelope, and explicitly unmet adverse heat scenarios. Native barrel crossing/path gates are present.

Forward limitations are accurately retained: any endcap envelope intersection is **1.34835–3.28360**, full axial containment **1.42423–3.19785**; η4 misses the active wheels. At η1.35, only **0.518 mm barrel radial envelope** and **9.468 mm endcap axial envelope** remain. Continuous depth, endcap saved Geant4 hits, response, field and engineering qualification remain outstanding.

No edits, native jobs or sign-off performed.
